bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
case "$(git remote get-url origin)" in *seigo-gace/create-videobot*) ;; *) exit 51;; esac
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
sha="faaae3e88c99a7cdfa85a70c91b6b585e3cd7a0d"
stage="$root/.worktrees/creator-entry-faaae3e"
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 52
test -z "$(git -C "$stage" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" || exit 53
ids="$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$ids" | grep -c .)" -eq 1 || exit 54
old="$ids"
oldid="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$old")"
oldtag="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Config.Image}}' "$old")"
case "$oldtag" in create-videobot:*) ;; *) echo CREATOR_NOT_OWNED_IMAGE; exit 55;; esac
alias="create-videobot:creator-entry-live-base-faaae3e"
if docker image inspect "$alias" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$alias")" = "$oldid" || { echo CREATOR_BASE_ALIAS_DIFFERENT; exit 56; }
else
 docker image tag "$oldid" "$alias"
fi
docker build --pull=false --network none -t create-videobot:creator-entry-faaae3e -f - "$stage" <<'DOCKERFILE'
FROM create-videobot:creator-entry-live-base-faaae3e
USER root
RUN node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs");const p="/opt/videobot/src/telegram/menuPanel.mjs";let s=fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8");const before="[[\u0027🎬 動画\u0027,\u0027menu:video\u0027],[\u0027🎨 ステッカー/絵文字\u0027,\u0027menu:stickers\u0027]]";const after="[[\u0027🎬 ビデオ\u0027,\u0027menu:listing\u0027],[\u0027🎨 ステッカー／絵文字\u0027,\u0027menu:stickers\u0027]]";if(!s.includes(before))throw Error("CREATOR_LANDING_BASELINE_MISMATCH");fs.writeFileSync(p,s.replace(before,after));'
USER node
DOCKERFILE
docker run --rm --pull never --network none --read-only --entrypoint node -v "$stage/test:/opt/videobot/test:ro" create-videobot:creator-entry-faaae3e --test test/menuPanel.test.mjs test/creatorBot.test.mjs test/creatorSourceIntegration.test.mjs
echo CREATOR_EDITOR_CURRENT_IMAGE_PATCH_TEST=PASS
echo CREATOR_EDITOR_BASE_IMAGE_ID="$oldid"
echo CREATOR_EDITOR_IMAGE_READY=PASS
